text:
marie: Quick thread — Crestline Account Summit next Tue 10am PT. Need slide owners, exec asks, demo readiness, and a lightweight feedback capture plan. Can we do a 20m pre-dryrun Mon so execs see the flow? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jordan: 10am PT on Tue is on exec calendar. Mon pre-dryrun 2pm PT works for me. Who's owning the stakeholder slide?

sanjay: I can own the live demo and smoke tests. I need a short runbook + a test key. @todd can you provision a limited test key for demo traffic?

ella: I'll take the product/roadmap slide — 90s top-line and one potential risk note for renewals. Will post a 1-slide PNG by EOD Mon.

marie: Awesome. I'll coordinate the exec asks: 3 bullets (ROI since onboarding, adoption lift, renewal health). Draft below — comments welcome:
- ROI: usage delta + 2 customer wins since integration
- Adoption: 75% of seats active, highlight two power users
- Renewal health: contract up for renewal in 6 weeks, risk flagged for feature parity ask

marie: Action items quick list (owner — due):
- Demo infra & smoke tests — sanjay — Mon 11am PT
- Test key for demo — todd — Mon 10:30am PT
- Slide: product & roadmap — ella — Mon EOD
- Slide: customer health snapshot — marie — Mon noon PT
- Exec dryrun facilitation & cue cards — jordan — Mon 2pm PT
- Feedback capture form + live Qs template — marie — Mon 1pm PT

ops-bot: Reminder: meeting room booked Crestline_Summit_Room_B (10am PT Tue). Recording enabled.

todd: Provisioned a demo key: crestline-demo-key-rcv. Sanjay I DM'd the secret; rotate after demo.

sanjay: Got it, testing now. Quick log snippet if anyone needs to validate payloads:
```
POST /v1/generate 200 OK
{"request_id":"abc123","tokens":120}
```

ella: Slide note — adding a single sentence on planned latency improvements from batching config. Keeping it high level.

marie: Feedback capture plan: 1) Short Google form sent immediately after summit (3 questions + NPS) 2) Live Qs in Slack thread using #crestline-feedback for follow-ups 3) Assign one CSM follow-up per flagged concern within 48h.

jordan: Agree. Let's add an ask: if exec raises a compliance question, escalate to eng-security and tag me.

marie: Scheduling: I'll send calendar invite for Mon dryrun 2pm PT and attach slide deck link. Also will create the #crestline-feedback channel and pre-populate the form link.

sanjay: One small risk: demo depends on feature flag ff-online-search. If it's off in staging we'll fallback to recorded clip. I'll add that to the cue cards.

ella: Noted. I'll add a one-liner on fallback in the roadmap slide (transparent fallback = lowers renewal risk).

marie: Perfect. Thanks all — I'll post the deck link once slides are in. :rocket:

jordan: Thanks — see you Mon dryrun. :thumbsup:
